phase: base lab environment; OIDC fixture with two issuers running

steps.action: Prepare a disposable Administrator with a password and no authenticator
steps.actual: DOC-032 admin-org V-C37 2FA admin was invited as Administrator, set a password and signed in (administrator).

steps.action: Turn on Require two-factor authentication under Legal User Authentication as an Administrator with no authenticator: OpenLaw asks for set-up before continuing
steps.expected: Enrolment page with the organization requirement; API refused until enrolment; enrolment reaches the app
steps.actual: Require two-factor authentication was off. Selecting it under Legal User Authentication saved it on and took the Administrator to /auth/two-factor/enroll with "Your organization requires two-factor authentication."; an admin API call answered 403 ("Set up two-factor authentication before continuing."). After Turn on two-factor, a code, Confirm and Done, the Administrator reached / and the same API answered 200.

steps.action: Each new session must prove a code
steps.expected: A fresh password sign-in asks for a code
steps.actual: A fresh password sign-in went to /auth/two-factor with "Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app." Before the code an admin API call answered 401; after Verify it answered 200.

steps.action: Required two-factor authentication applies to email magic links and to single sign-on, and to Administrator emergency password sign-in
steps.expected: Magic-link and SSO sign-ins of staff without an authenticator are sent to set-up; Daniel's password sign-in with Email and password off is sent to set-up
steps.actual: Observed {"magicLink":{"path":"/auth/two-factor/enroll","work":403},"sso":{"callback":"/auth/two-factor/enroll","me":200,"setupRequired":true,"path":"/auth/two-factor/enroll","work":403},"emergencyPassword":{"path":"/auth/two-factor/enroll","work":403}}. Legal SSO was turned off and Email and password turned back on ({"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":true}).
The switch showed "Saved" ({"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}). The disposable Administrator's authenticator stays enrolled.
